name: 37138 · Old Hickory, TN
findings: ZIP 37138 (Old Hickory) has 76 nonprofit organizations. 23 of them (30%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 19 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (30% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 37138 (Old Hickory) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 37138 (Old Hickory) list public events in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 46% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 24 organizations here; 36% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find public events now, including outside formal organizations?
